cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All those speech lessons from me, and your wedding toast thanked 'the buffet.' The buffet has a name.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you cooked. I was trying to keep it short.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you remembered one lesson. Try the one about making people feel appreciated. Start with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll thank you when I announce dessert. One sentence; people are waiting to eat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One is plenty. Lead with my name, like I taught you to lead with the important thing. The pudding can come second.

reason: Replace a pronunciation question the scene did not answer with a real timing and length constraint; A can then correct the order of the promised thanks.
